# Golden fixtures

`golden/` is copied unchanged from the LearnHarness project's
`tests/fixtures/golden-data/` (AGPL-3.0, <https://github.com/amosblomqvist/learnharness>).
It exercises the readers in `internal/data` against the format the app
actually writes, instead of only hand-written samples.

Do not edit these files to make a test pass. A compatibility change belongs in
the app's format and must be reflected there first.
